items.title: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says
items.summary: A woman who alleges she was raped by the jailed comedian when she was 16 is campaigning to see relationships between 16-and 17-year-olds and adults made illegal.

items.title: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
items.summary: Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving, police say.

items.title: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
items.summary: Warren Arter faced claims of sexually exploiting crime victims - his wife was found in a blood-stained room.

items.title: Minister backs legal right to job support for young people
items.summary: The work and pensions secretary said the level of support currently on offer was too vague.

items.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.summary: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Hannah Fry feels 'unbelievably lucky' after cervical cancer treatment
items.summary: The presenter says she has received a 'five-year clear' after having a hysterectomy in her thirties.

items.title: Watch: SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
items.summary: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

items.title: Judo champion shakes up French presidential race with surprise candidacy
items.summary: Teddy Riner is one of the most popular figures in modern-day France, and one in five voters say they could support him.
